title: Keto Syrian Black Bean Kebabs
description: A keto twist on traditional kebabs, using flavorful black beans and a spicy Syrian seasoning blend.

ingredients.name: Syrian seasoning blend
ingredients.notes: Keto-friendly blend of herbs and spices

instructions: In a large bowl, combine cooked black beans, Syrian seasoning blend, and black pepper.
Squeeze lime juice over the bean mixture and mix well.
Thread a few black beans onto each wooden skewer, leaving a small space between each bean.
Brush the kebabs with olive oil and wrap each kebab in aluminum foil to prevent sticking.
Place the kebabs on a baking sheet and bake for 15-20 minutes, or until heated through.
Remove the kebabs from the oven and let them cool for a few minutes.
Serve the kebabs hot, garnished with fresh herbs if desired.
